blocks.text: PASSENGER LIABILITY WAIVER AND RELEASE OF LIABILITY
This Passenger Waiver and Release ("Waiver") is entered into on {{date}} between:
Passenger acknowledges that transportation services involve inherent risks, including but not limited to:

items: Traffic accidents, collisions, and related injuries.
Mechanical failures or vehicle malfunctions.
Weather-related hazards and road conditions.
Negligence or actions of other drivers, passengers, pedestrians, or third parties.
Sudden stops, starts, or changes in direction.
Injury from objects within the vehicle.
{{risk_factors}}

blocks.text: Passenger voluntarily accepts and assumes all such risks, known and unknown, even if caused by the negligence of the Operator.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, Passenger hereby releases, waives, and discharges:

items: The Operator, its owners, operators, employees, agents, and affiliates (collectively, "Released Parties").
Any claim, demand, action, or cause of action arising from or related to any loss, damage, injury, or death sustained while using the transportation service.
Claim for pain and suffering, emotional distress, or punitive damages.
Any liability for property damage affecting Passenger's personal belongings.

blocks.text: This release includes claims based on the acts or omissions of any Released Party, even if arising from negligence.
Passenger agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Released Parties from any claims, losses, or expenses (including attorney fees) arising from:

items: Passenger's own negligence or misconduct.
Passenger's violation of any law, rule, or regulation.
Passenger's damage to the Vehicle or property.
Passenger's interference with the Operator's safe operation of the Vehicle.
{{indemnification_scope}}
Passenger is in good physical health and capable of using transportation services.
Passenger has no medical condition that could be aggravated by transportation.
Passenger is not under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
Passenger has no contagious disease that could endanger others.
{{medical_certification}}
Operator may carry insurance coverage, but Passenger is not a named insured.
Passenger is encouraged to maintain personal health insurance and/or travel insurance.
This Waiver does not affect Passenger's insurance coverage from other sources.
Operator's insurance coverage, if any, is subject to its terms, conditions, and exclusions.

blocks.text: Passenger waives any claim for consequential, indirect, incidental, special, or punitive damages.
If any provision of this Waiver is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
This Waiver is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}. The parties agree to submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in {{governing_state}}.

This Waiver constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements. Passenger acknowledges having read, understood, and voluntarily signed this Waiver.
